approach: Follow the existing sjawhar/legion-smoke proof convention: a single-line Markdown marker file under smoke/ named for the issue. Add smoke/S393189958-1.md containing exactly one line that includes the literal text S393189958-1. Chosen over editing an existing shared file (README.md, smoke.txt) because a new per-issue file avoids merge contention with concurrent smoke issues and matches the dominant convention in smoke/ (e.g. S394570180-1.md, S393569515-1.md). No source, workflow (.github/workflows), or config changes — spec Scope forbids anything beyond the one smoke/ file plus an optional single appended line on review.
implementEvidence: E2E (implementer): after adding smoke/S393189958-1.md, run cat smoke/S393189958-1.md and grep -c S393189958-1 smoke/S393189958-1.md; observed single line containing S393189958-1 and count 1 (negative control: count 0 on main before the change). Record the head SHA. Open the PR with body line 'Dispatch: S393189958-1'. CI (the sleep-only ci workflow) settles green.
integrationEvidence: Root outcome and adopted child S393189958-5 each add one single-line smoke/ file; integrated as one unit (spec: no further children needed). Tree signs off only when child S393189958-5 reaches done with its file present.
ordering: Single task T1; no intra-issue ordering. Child S393189958-5 was released as Wave 1 after spec approval and proceeds independently; tree sign-off waits on the child reaching done.
